stem.x: The functional size of a new system was estimated to be 500 function points (FPs). Apart from development, the project requires 10 person-months in total for installation of the system and education of developers. Additionally project management requires 10% of the total person-months of development, installation, and education. How many person-months are required in total for this project? Here, the productivity in development is 10 FPs per person-month.
